description_expanded: This unique home is truly built to enjoy all aspects of the outdoors. Most bedrooms open to outdoor hallways to provide ease of entry and privacy. Five bedrooms, all with private bath, are spread over multiple levels of the home. The first level offers a two-car garage, spacious courtyard with large reflecting fountain and two bedrooms, one with king-sized bed and one with four built-in bunk beds. Both bedrooms have exterior entrances to the courtyard as well as an interior connection. Progressing up an exterior staircase, guests will find the second level offering three bedrooms, including the primary suite, all with king-sized beds. As below, two of these bedrooms offer exterior entrances. An interior hallway connects two bedrooms and offers a laundry room. Interior and exterior staircases lead to the third level which features a spacious family room with large, open kitchen. An exterior staircase leads to a roof-top patio and private pool with ample seating and incredible views of Alys Beach. Parking for this home is located in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
